question: Who among the following won Poland’s Presidential Election held on 12 July 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andrzej Duda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Andrzej Duda's first term ended on 6 August 2020, when he confirmed his oath of office before the National Assembly, a joint session of the Sejm and Senate, and began his second term**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Andrzej Sebastian Duda** is a Polish lawyer and politician who has served as President of Poland since 2015.

 
 
• He was elected to the Sejm from 2011 to 2014 and European Parliament from 2014 until 2015.
 
 
 
• On 26 May 2015, Duda resigned his party membership and the European Parliament as the president-elect.
 
• In the first round of voting, Duda received 5,179,092 votes – 34.76% of valid votes.
 
• In the second round of voting, he officially received 51.55% of the vote, defeating the incumbent president Bronisław Komorowski, who received 48.45% of the vote.
